welcome.title: Make your first synced TTML
welcome.description: The guide stays with you, opens the right tools, and waits until each required task is actually complete.
welcome.own: Guide me through my first TTML

beforeStart.title: Before you start:
beforeStart.text: You can change how the editor looks to suit you. Click below to open the settings. Try the simple layout, or switch to the advanced layout for full control.

status.complete: Done. The tool detected that this step is complete.

genius.title: Create a Genius access token
genius.step1: 1. Open Genius API Clients and sign in.
genius.step2: 2. Select New API Client, give it any recognizable app name, and fill the required app website field.
genius.step3: 3. Save the client, then select Generate Access Token.
genius.step4: 4. Copy the Client Access Token, not the Client ID or Client Secret.
genius.reuse: The tool stores this token locally and reuses it for lyric imports and songwriter lookup.

intro.title: Read the full guide first
intro.description: This built-in guide is a hands-on companion to the full TTML guide. Read the full guide for the concepts, then keep this panel open while you apply them in the editor.
intro.waiting: Read the full guide, then continue when you are ready to begin.

audio.title: Import the song
audio.description: Choose the exact recording you are making lyrics for. The guide will continue once the audio finishes loading.
audio.waiting: Use “Choose audio” below, then wait for loading to finish.

lyrics.title: Import the lyrics
lyrics.description: Choose a lyrics source below. It opens the import screen, where you can switch between Paste, LRCLIB and Genius at the top, clean up the text and import it.
lyrics.waiting: Choose a source below and import the lyrics from the import screen.

review.title: Check lyrics and line types
review.description: Read every line against the recording. Double-click words to fix them; select lines to mark background or duet vocals. Remove empty lines, then confirm below.
review.waiting: The structure is valid. Finish reading the lyrics, then confirm your review.
review.waitingEmptyLines: At least one empty lyric line remains. Delete or fill it before confirming.

sync.title: Sync every word
sync.description: Enter Time mode, select the first word, press Space, then use F to start, G between words, and H at pauses or line endings. Every word must receive a valid time.
sync.waiting: Open Time mode and keep timing; this completes when every applicable word has a valid start and end.

songwriters.title: Add songwriters
songwriters.description: Open metadata and use Fetch songwriters from Genius, or add one Songwriter value per real name. The guide detects when at least one is saved.
songwriters.waiting: Open metadata and add at least one non-empty Songwriter value.

export.title: Export the TTML
export.description: Save the finished TTML. This step completes only after a file is actually written.
export.waiting: Choose Save TTML and complete the file picker.

test.title: Test locally
test.description: Upload the saved file in Spicy Lyrics and check parsing, formatting, and timing.
test.waiting: Open the local testing instructions, verify the file in Spicy Lyrics, then finish the guide.

importLyrics.title: Import lyrics
importLyrics.description: Paste lyrics or find them online, tidy them up, then import.
importLyrics.textPlaceholder: Paste lyrics here, one line per row. Section headers like [Chorus] go on their own row.
importLyrics.processHint: Splits words, tidies punctuation and spacing, and moves parenthesized vocals to background lines.
importLyrics.splitHint: Marks syllables with the word separator, using your segmentation settings and learned splits. Fix any marks in the text before importing.
importLyrics.splitDone: Syllables marked. Check them before importing.
importLyrics.sectionsFound: {count, plural, one {# header found} other {# headers found}}
importLyrics.makeSectionsHint: Each header starts a section. Turns on Genius sections.
importLyrics.removeHeadersHint: Drops the header rows from the lyrics.
importLyrics.reviewHint: Fix any category that was guessed wrong. Colors, vocalists and notes can be set later from the section menu.
importLyrics.importFailed: Couldn't read these lyrics. Check the text and the text format settings.

processSteps.removeInlineBracketsHint: Drops [notes] in the middle of a line. Header rows are kept.
processSteps.backgroundVocalsHint: Moves (vocals) to their own background line.

processSteps.emDashesHint: Turns double hyphens and stray hyphens into em dashes.
processSteps.splitHyphensHint: Splits words like mm-hmm after the hyphen.
processSteps.splitCjkHint: Splits Chinese, Japanese and Korean text into characters and at script changes.
processSteps.punctuationSpacingHint: One space after commas, none before punctuation, and quotes kept on their word.
processSteps.collapseSpacesHint: Turns runs of spaces into one.
processSteps.splitWordsHint: Marks each space as a word boundary for the import.

aboutModal.creditsIntro: This project includes work adapted from the following open-source projects.
aboutModal.communityDesc: Help us make the tool better by contributing code, reporting issues, or providing translations.

spectrogramLanes.settingDesc: Draw background lines in their own row under the main lines. Lanes are view-only: change a line's role in Edit mode.

spectrogramLineEnds.mergedHandle: Line and last word end. Alt-drag to move only one.

spectrogram.noAudioLoaded: Load an audio file to show the spectrogram

spectrogramFollow.settingDesc: Scrolls the spectrogram to keep the playhead in view. Scrolling or dragging pauses it until you press play or leave it for a moment.
spectrogramFollow.pageDesc: Jumps ahead when the playhead leaves the view.
spectrogramFollow.continuousDesc: Scrolls with the playhead and keeps it centered.

export.recoveryUntimed: This recovery export contains untimed lyrics. Check timing before submitting.
export.recoveryReviewFailed: Timing checks could not run. Review the recovered lyrics before submitting.
